join hortbot 2 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] There are no quotes.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "quote 1"
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "quote 1" added as quote #1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "quote 2"
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "quote 2" added as quote #2.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote random
send_match hortbot #foobar \[HB\] Quote #(1: "quote 1"|2: "quote 2")

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote random
send_match hortbot #foobar \[HB\] Quote #(1: "quote 1"|2: "quote 2")

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote
send_match hortbot #foobar \[HB\] Quote #(1: "quote 1"|2: "quote 2")

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote
send_match hortbot #foobar \[HB\] Quote #(1: "quote 1"|2: "quote 2")

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 :!quote
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 access=subscriber :!quote
send_match hortbot #foobar \[HB\] Quote #(1: "quote 1"|2: "quote 2")
